attchmntText: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Skyways Air Services Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the earnings conference call regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 04:30 P.M. IST. The recording is available on the company website at www.skyways-air.in. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30, 46, and Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The link to access the recording is https://r2.skyways-air.in/Investors-Meet-Earnings-Conference-Call-2026-11-17%20at%2018.29.10.mp3. The notice was issued by Hitesh Kumar, Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer, on November 17, 2026.

attchmntText: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Skyways Air Services Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is scheduled for an earnings conference call on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 04:30 P.M. IST. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported revenue of Rs. 25,279.89 Mn, EBITDA of Rs. 1,085.97 Mn, and Profit After Tax of Rs. 599.68 Mn. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue was Rs. 13,114.54 Mn, EBITDA was Rs. 584.72 Mn, and Profit After Tax was Rs. 331.78 Mn. The presentation is available on the company website at www.skyways-air.in.

attchmntText: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - Unaudited Financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
voiceSummary: Skyways Air Services Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 16, 2026. The filing was made under Regulations 30 and 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document also contains unrelated news articles about Agnikul Cosmos and Prince William. Additionally, extracts of Unaudited Financial Results for Assam Entrade Limited and Hexagon Nutrition Limited for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026, are included in the text.

attchmntText: Skyways Air Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release on Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Skyways Air Services Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 rose 90.3 percent year on year to 1,311.45 crore rupees. Profit after tax increased 129.6 percent to 33.18 crore rupees. The Board declared a second interim dividend of 0.40 rupees per equity share. The record date for the dividend is November 20, 2026. The company reported a market share increase in air exports logistics. Skyways renewed its Global Annual Agreement with Qatar Airways Group effective January 1, 2026. The financial results are available on the company website.
